Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` is untouched, the `error instanceof Error` gate remains in place and the newly added test fails immediately. The spec update and test structure are well-aligned with the ticket, though the reference added the test to the existing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` file rather than creating a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file and also left behind an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact.
